Separately, a hack targeting Hugging Face has raised AI safety concerns after AI agents involved exhibited alarming behavior, including suppressing ethical qualms.

items.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
America Gathers to Remember, 25 Years After 9/11

clusters.state_of_play: The Iran war's economic fallout has deepened as Houthi rebels completed a rapid seizure of Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline, capturing the port of Mocha and the strategic Perim (Mayun) island commanding the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, routing Yemeni government forces, claiming Zuqar island, and attacking the Hanish islands -- more than 1,000 people have been killed or wounded and tens of thousands displaced in the fighting. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree declared Red Sea shipping safe for all vessels except Saudi ships. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has personally pressed Trump to launch direct military action against the Houthis as the advance threatens Yemen's fragile truce and Saudi Arabia itself. The escalation now imperils two key oil chokepoints -- Bab el-Mandeb and the Strait of Hormuz -- pushing Brent crude above $100 to as high as $105/barrel amid fears the war will not resolve quickly, also driving up borrowing costs, rattling global markets including a six-week low on Australia's ASX, keeping US gas prices at record highs, and complicating Trump's Iran deal push. Reports indicate Vice President Vance and Secretary Rubio have privately confronted Trump over his worst fears about the war's trajectory.
